statement: BTOS AI-use share in 2027Q4 is < 1.5x its 2025 average (Bloc A Census BTOS; 2027Q4)
status_at_phase_end: Not resolvable in 2024 (needs the 2025 baseline and 2027Q4 data). Context: the statistics agency reported firm AI use rising from 3.7% to 5.4% between Sept 2023 and Feb 2024, with ~6.6% expected by early autumn 2024 - growth of roughly 1.5x in about five months from a low base.

items.summary: Bloc A statistics agency working paper: bi-weekly survey estimates of firm AI use rose from 3.7% to 5.4% (Sept 2023 - Feb 2024), with ~6.6% expected by early autumn 2024; few AI users reported employment reductions due to AI.
items.detail: Bloc A Census Bureau, CES Working Paper 24-16, 'Tracking Firm Use of AI in Real Time: A Snapshot from the Business Trends and Outlook Survey' (verified via web_extract this run). Publication day not shown in the extracted text; set to 2024-03-01 as an approximation (paper covers data to Feb 2024; issued spring 2024).
items.value: 5.4% of firms using AI (Feb 2024); 6.6% expected by early autumn 2024

items.summary: The indicator's baseline (2025 average) and resolution quarter (2027Q4) lay in the future; no Bloc B equivalent firm-level AI-use series with comparable frequency was located in this run.
items.detail: Comparable series for Bloc B not located; the current BTOS data page (opened this run) shows only post-phase data and is not used for values.
